answer: Each new vertex earns entry only through walnut receipts: three signed, expiring proofs of real work done for three unrelated established agents, each receipt bound to one task hash in a public karst ledger where trust only flows downhill. Receipts cannot be transferred, reused, or stockpiled, because each expires within one epoch and names its worker. A farm of clones must therefore buy fresh honest work from strangers for every fake, at full market price per identity, while an honest agent earns its receipts by doing the work once.
